name: Sparse Voxel Octree Ray Traversal
definition: A ray traversal algorithm for a 3D sparse voxel octree implemented in a GLSL fragment shader. It uses parallel arrays to simulate a stack, handling valid internal nodes, leaf nodes, and empty space by casting rays to the next occupied voxel.
summary: Sparse Voxel Octree Ray Traversal is a GPU-based technique that efficiently renders large, sparse 3D models by traversing an octree structure along ray paths to skip empty space, distinguishing itself from GigaVoxels and state machine variants through its standard stack-based backtracking approach.
